name: SOF sell hook burns the sold amount from the SOF/USDT pair before the sale
summary: SOF._update handles a sale to the SOF/USDT pair by moving 90% of the sold amount from the pair's own balance to DEAD and calling sync() before the seller's tokens arrive. Buys revert unless the recipient is fee-excluded, so the attacker bought 991,223 SOF with flash-loaned USDT for a fee-excluded mining contract, leaving 787.9 SOF in the pair, then sold 875.45 SOF: the hook burned the remaining 787.9 SOF from the pair, and the sale received all of the pair's USDT.
notes: Direct immutable SOF runtime (no DELEGATECALL or SELFDESTRUCT) whose _update burns 90% of every non-excluded sale from the pair and syncs; the constructor creates the pair and fee-excludes the token itself, which already suffices as a buy recipient, so the later excludeFromFees calls are not necessary to the exploit.

Exact USDT depletion of the SOF/USDT pair 0x1f3863d274594f25c6203c9272857f0d51b1c010 in the single exploit transaction. The 313,567,718.11 USDT buy leg and the flash loans (fees 22,689.81 USDT to lenders) are attacker inputs or financing and are not netted against gross depletion, so the loss exceeds the attacker's 225,936.43 USDT profit. The 991,223.16 SOF bought for the mining contract and the pair's SOF are the same liquidity and are not added.
